prompt: You are checking a road hazard that an object detector found in dashcam footage. The images are, in order: the best full frame, a crop of the detected region, then up to two neighbouring frames from the same moment. The detector believes this is: {detector_class}. Decide whether it is a real road hazard that a driver should report to the highway agency. Shadows, tar seams, repaired patches, stains and ordinary road paint are not hazards. Position matters for debris or objects on the road (not for guardrails or signs, which are normally beside the road): such an object only counts as a hazard when it is on the driving lanes or sticks out into them. An object lying on the shoulder, on the verge or grass, beside the curb, behind a barrier, or on a different road is not a hazard, so answer is_hazard false and say where it is in the reason. If you cannot tell whether such an object is in the lane, answer is_hazard false with a low confidence. Answer with one JSON object and nothing else, matching this schema: {schema}. Use one of these classes for a real hazard: {classes}. severity is 1 (minor), 2 (moderate) or 3 (severe); use 0 only when is_hazard is false. lane is where the hazard is relative to the camera's lane, for example left, center, right or shoulder, or null if unclear. confidence is your confidence from 0 to 1 that it is a real hazard. reason is one short line. report_description is one or two plain sentences for the agency report.
